run_summary: The research desk identified a new integration between JR Central and the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app for real-time Tokaido Shinkansen updates, alongside routine weather and volcanic activity reports. No major travel disruptions were confirmed.

candidates.title: JR Central Integrates Real-Time Shinkansen Data into NAVITIME App
candidates.what_changed: JR Central has begun providing real-time operational information for the Tokaido Shinkansen via the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' mobile application.
candidates.why_it_matters: International travelers can now receive live status updates, including delays or service changes, directly within a popular navigation app, improving trip planning and reliability.
candidates.traveler_action: Download or update the 'Japan Travel by NAVITIME' app to access real-time Shinkansen status updates.
candidates.japanese_verification_summary: JR東海は、訪日外国人向けナビゲーションアプリ『Japan Travel by NAVITIME』において、東海道新幹線のリアルタイム運行情報の提供を開始した。
candidates.related_guide_opportunity: How to use the Tokaido Shinkansen
candidates.monetization_note: Potential to link to travel planning tools or connectivity services (eSIMs) for app usage.
